verdict.rationale: ESD publishes an online sign-in path: employers log into SecureAccess Washington (SAW) to reach EAMS, and the probe confirms the secure portal presents a SAW login shell. That points to a remote credential login rather than an in-person step, but nothing in the pack says what the second factor is or rules out biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN. missing for 10: documentation that SAW sign-in uses credential MFA (e.g., an authenticator app, SMS or email code), confirmation that no biometric, in-person or mailed-PIN identity proofing is required for employer access, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sign-in flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail

citations.quote: Log into SecureAccess Washington (SAW) to access EAMS and make changes to your quarterly report.
